heading: What’s inside, for agents and teams
title: The same system, built for how clients choose an agent.

items.name: Weekly Pulse
items.text: A one page read on how you showed up this week, and the one thing to do next.

items.name: Lift Score
items.text: One number that shows whether you are getting easier to find in your market.

items.name: AI Shortlist
items.text: Know whether AI assistants recommend you when people ask for an agent, and who they recommend instead.

items.name: Map Reach
items.text: Where you appear in Google Maps across the neighborhoods you sell in.

items.name: Site Read
items.text: Make sure Google and AI tools describe you, your listings and your areas correctly.

items.name: Daily Presence
items.text: Fresh posts that keep your name in front of buyers and sellers, written for your market.

items.name: Market Survey
items.text: See what competing agents are doing in your market before it costs you a listing.

items.name: Review Desk
items.text: Review replies in your voice that turn happy clients into proof for the next one.

items.name: Snapshot
items.text: Calls, website clicks and direction requests from Google, in plain language.

items.name: ClearView
items.text: Your social report: what posted, what people engaged with and what changes next.
